project.name: Likeness Drift Lab
project.description: Zero-API Android tool for simulating, compounding, and benchmarking facial likeness drift across AI video generation runs (LTX-Video, Wan, Runway) and validating agent re-anchoring pipelines.

build_and_packaging.quick_start: Execute gradle assembleDebug to build the debug APK immediately.
build_and_packaging.zero_api_notice: No external cloud APIs, API keys, or backend services are needed. All image processing, mesh deformation, and delta analysis are executed entirely on-device via Android Canvas & Bitmaps.

DriftEngine.description: High-performance on-device 2D mesh deformation and pixel delta calculation engine.

methods.applyDrift: Warps source bitmap using Canvas.drawBitmapMesh (26x26 grid, 729 vertices) with smooth cubic Hermite falloff displacement around facial landmarks (eyes, mouth, jaw). Applies latent diffusion micro-softening and chromatic temperature shifts.
methods.generateDifferenceHeatmap: Amplifies pixel-level differences (7.5x) and maps delta values to a false-color spectrum (Cyan -> Green -> Yellow -> Hot Red) to reveal invisible spatial drift.
methods.calculateRealImageDifference: Compares an actual Control/Reference photo against a real video frame or agent fix, outputting quantified likeness retention % and peak/mean pixel displacement.
methods.calculateMetrics: Computes mathematical likeness retention %, eye asymmetry %, and agent verdict (e.g. PASS vs RE-ANCHOR REQUIRED).

DriftViewModel.description: Central state manager handling photo selection, compound generation cycles, presets, benchmark comparisons, and file export.
key_states: driftedBitmap: Current output frame (simulated or real test frame)
isComparisonMode: Toggles between synthetic Drift Simulator and 2-Photo Benchmark Test Bed
currentGen: Generation depth (Gen 0, Gen 1, Gen 2, etc.)

ImageUtils.description: Image loading, downsampling (max 1024px for smooth 60fps), MediaStore saving (JPEG/PNG in Pictures/LikenessDriftLab), and FileProvider sharing Intent.

DriftLabScreen.description: Main UI featuring TopAppBar, Mode Switcher (Simulator vs 2-Photo Benchmark), interactive Split Slider, Delta Heatmap, Metrics Card, 1-tap Export buttons, and Drift Controls deck.

agent_testing_workflow.step_1_drift_simulation: User dials in drift or taps 'Compound Step (+1 Clip)' to generate synthetic video drift across multiple clips.
agent_testing_workflow.step_2_export_to_agent: User taps 'Save JPEG' or 'Share to Fixer' to send the drifted frame to the agent (Muse).
agent_testing_workflow.step_3_agent_re_anchoring: The agent inspects the frame, detects eye/mouth landmark displacement against the original reference, in-paints/re-generates the face, and returns a fixed image.
agent_testing_workflow.step_4_real_world_verification: User switches to '2-Photo Test Bed' mode, loads the Control Photo into Slot 1 and the Agent's fixed image into Slot 2. The Delta Heatmap confirms if the fix successfully restored likeness (Score >= 95% = PASS).
